On Sun, Jan 3, 2016 at 10:52 PM, Kyle Doherty <kyledavi...@gmail.com> wrote:
I have a large dataset that I download, unzip to a temp folder, and then read before shinyServer(). It takes about 30 seconds to download, and I want users to know this so they know the app isn't dead in the water. 

withProgress() doesn't seem to work outside of shinyServer(), so I'm wondering what my options are here.

I was thinking of just adding some helpText in the sidebar, and then rendering some text once the files are read to the effect of, "App initialized, ready to go!"

Any more elegant solutions out there?

Thanks!

--

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Progress bar or message before shinyServer() for large file downloads to temp folder?
parts:
You could put your "app loading" message in a conditionalPanel, where the condition is the negation of an output that'll definitely be present when the app finishes loading.

ui <- fluidPage(
  conditionalPanel("!output.foo", "App is loading, may take a while"),
  plotOutput("foo")
)
